issues.detail: Threads TH2 (12 messages), TH3 (14 messages), and TH4 (14 messages) fall below the minimum required 17 messages per thread.
In TH5, mandatory decisions D1 and D6 are missing from the decision_refs of all messages in the thread, despite being required by the blueprint and listed in the thread_outcome.

Participants share a very similar, overly formal and structured tone (e.g., 'Perfect. So here's the plan...', 'Excellent. So to confirm...'), lacking distinct personas or realistic casual Slack dynamics.
